description: Original fictional data contract for a plant inspection feed delivered as CSV text. Row rules decide whether one row is admissible; batch rules need every row of the delivery and the manifest.

fields.name: event_id
fields.meaning: one delivered payload; a repeat with the same payload is a duplicate delivery, a repeat with a different payload is a contradiction

fields.name: inspection_id
fields.meaning: business key; versions are comparable within one inspection only

text_rules: values are trimmed; an empty string after trimming is missing; integer text must match ^[+-]?[0-9]+$ (so 12.0 and twelve are invalid); dates must be ISO calendar dates

row_rules.rule: defective_units <= inspected_units, checked only when both parsed as integers
an accepted row with inspected_units == 0 has defect_rate null: never 0.0 and never a division error

batch_rules.rule: the same event_id with an identical payload: the first row is kept, later repeats are quarantined; disclosed, does not block
the same event_id with a different payload: every such row is quarantined; blocks publication
the same (inspection_id, version) with different quantities under different event IDs: every such row is quarantined; blocks publication
the same (inspection_id, version) with identical quantities under different event IDs: later rows are quarantined as redundant; disclosed, does not block
within one inspection_id, revised_at must not decrease as version increases; every row of that inspection is quarantined; blocks publication
manifest delivered_rows must equal the number of data rows in the CSV; blocks publication
every required field must be a CSV column; blocks publication

reason_order: for each field in contract order: missing_<field>, then invalid_<field>, then below_minimum_<field>, then unknown_<label> for a reference; then defective_exceeds_inspected; batch reasons follow row reasons
publication_rule: publication_allowed is true only when there are no contradictions and no batch failures; row-level quarantine is disclosed and does not block
